lines.text: Cosmo! Cosmo, wake up!
Your best friend Sprockle is shaking you awake, his antennae twitching like crazy.
I've been watching the galaxy all night, and something big is happening! Want me to tell you about it?
Should Sprockle tell you what's happening? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Oh! Okay, no rush.
Sprockle fiddles with his gadgets, bouncing on his toes.
But it's really, really important, Cosmo. The whole galaxy might depend on it! Ready to hear what I found?
Ready to hear what Sprockle discovered? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
That's okay, Cosmo. We'll save the galaxy another day. Get some rest, buddy.
Sprockle pulls out a glowing hologram map.

Okay, so here's the thing. Our galaxy, Nutria, used to have three planets. Frootopia, Vegonnia, and Zoomara. But then the Mucklars came. Dark, gloopy creatures. And they wiped out Vegonnia completely!
Should I tell you about the Mucklars?
Want to hear about the Mucklars? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Fair enough. The history stuff is scary anyway! Long story short: gloopy creatures, bad. Frootopia, good. And we've got the Great Froot Tree protecting us. You know, the tree you clean the pipes for!
Ooh, look, Gribbo just walked into the café. Want to go say hi?
Should we go and talk to Gribbo? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
No worries, Gribbo's always around anyway.
Sprockle turns back to his gadgets. Suddenly, his Pingotron three thousand starts beeping like crazy!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Cosmo, this is a signal from where Vegonnia used to be! Should we check it out?
Should we check out the signal? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Yeah. Probably just another glitch.
Told ya!
But before anyone can relax, your communicator buzzes. Loudly.
That's your boss! Something's wrong, Cosmo. Are you going to answer?
Should you answer the call? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You let it ring. It stops. Then it buzzes again, with a voicemail alert.
Cosmo, that's your boss! If it's an emergency, we can't ignore it! Will you call back?
Will you call your boss back? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Okay, okay, then I will!
Before you can stop him, Sprockle taps your communicator and calls your boss back. The line connects, and he pushes the device into your hands.
Cosmo, talk! Will you take the call?
Will you take the call? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You try to push the communicator away, but your boss's voice booms through anyway, on the emergency channel.
Cosmo! This isn't optional! The Great Froot Tree is in trouble!
We have to listen.
Emergency! A big pipe on the Great Froot Tree has been damaged in an attack! If the water stops flowing, the tree could fail, and maybe all of Frootopia with it!
Cosmo! This is what you do! You fix pipes! We have to help!
My ship's right outside. Should we go?
Should we take Gribbo's ship and go help? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You hesitate. This is big. Sprockle squeezes your arm.
Cosmo, if the Great Froot Tree fails, everything fails.
Ship door's open, buddy. You in? Do we head out right now?
Do you head out right now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You freeze with one foot on the ramp, like you're posing for a heroic poster. The universe is not impressed.
If the Great Froot Tree stops flowing, everyone feels it, Cosmo. Can we please head out now?
Head out now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Everyone piles into Gribbo's clunky, fruit-filled spaceship. Tula takes a seat without a word. Sprockle starts scanning for danger.
She's not pretty, but she flies! Mostly.
Here we go, Cosmo! Ready for takeoff?
Ready for takeoff? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Wait, you say. You check your pipe kit. The seals. The wrenches. The extra-bendy pipe-cleaner.
Good call! Better prepared than panicked.
Okay, okay! Are we launching now?
Launch now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You check the seals on your pipe kit one more time. And then one more time, just to be sure. The engines rumble impatiently.
Every minute we sit here, we burn fuel, Cosmo. Shall we launch?
Launch now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You're flying through space when suddenly, Gribbo drops a peach. It rolls across the floor, bonks a big red button, and switches off the stealth mode!
Gribbo! They can see us now!
A patrol of Mucklar ships spots you! Tula cracks her knuckles.
We fight, or we run. Your call, Cosmo. Do we fight them?
Do we fight the Mucklars? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Punch it, Gribbo, you yell!
The fruit ship's engines scream as you zoom toward an asteroid field. Mucklar shots whizz past the windows!
I'm gonna be sick!
Almost there! Keep going into the asteroids?
Fly deeper into the asteroid field? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Pull up, you shout! Gribbo yanks the controls and the ship skims the edge of the asteroids instead.
A laser blast scorches the side of the ship!
Cosmo, we have to lose them! Go into the asteroids now?
Go into the asteroids now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The ship lurches as another blast scrapes the hull. Gribbo's snack tray floats off into the air.
Cosmo, those rocks are our only cover! Into the asteroids?
Go into the asteroids? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You wait too long. A Mucklar blast fizzles the engines, and your little fruit ship drifts to a stop. The Mucklars tow you away with a big sticky tractor beam.
Game over! Want to start the adventure again and try a different choice?
Want to play again? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
After a wild chase through the spinning rocks, you finally lose the Mucklars! The ship limps on, trailing smoke.
We made it! Barely!
Up ahead, you can see the damaged pipe, spraying water into space.
There it is. Ready to see the damage, Cosmo?
Ready to check the damaged pipe? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You take a second to breathe. Sprockle's antennae are still wobbling.
That was the scariest thing I've ever done.
Talking time is over. Pipe time. Ready to check the damage?
Ready to check the damage? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You stare at the broken pipe, misting water into space like the galaxy's saddest garden sprinkler.
Every second counts. Ready to check the damage?
Ready to check the damage? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Water from the Great Froot Tree is spraying everywhere! You look at the crack carefully. You can fix this. But you're missing a part.
This is your specialty, Cosmo! What do we need? Will you tell us?
Do you tell them what part you need? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
We need a hydro-valve coupler, you explain.
Those are super rare!
I know a place. The underground market. Bit shady, but they have everything.
I don't like it. But we don't have a choice.
What do you think, Cosmo? Should we go to the underground market?
Should we go to the underground market? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You search the floating junk nearby, but hydro-valve couplers are really rare. Precious time ticks away.
Cosmo, the tree's getting weaker! We need Gribbo's market!
The underground market it is. Ready to go?
Head to the underground market now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You wait another moment, and the hissing from the pipe gets louder.
Cosmo, please. Can we go to the market now?
Go to the market now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The pipe keeps hissing like a countdown with no off switch.
The underground market's gross, but it has parts. Also, at least three kinds of mystery smells. Shall we go?
Go to the market now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The underground market is a maze of flickering lights and very suspicious characters. Sprockle sticks close to you.
I don't like this place.
This guy's got everything!
Gribbo leads you to a junk dealer's stall.
A hydro-valve coupler? Oh, I've got one. But it's not for sale. Not for money, anyway.
Not for money? Maybe we should hear what he wants. Should we listen to his offer, Cosmo?
Should we hear the dealer's offer? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
No deals, you start to say. But Sprockle tugs your sleeve.
Cosmo, we need that part.
Listen to your friend. I don't want your money. I want a little wager.
Do you want to hear his offer?
Do you want to hear the dealer's offer? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You start to back away from the stall. The dealer's grin gets wider.
Leaving so soon? You haven't even heard my offer.
We can say no after we know what we're saying no to. Like reading the menu first! Hear his offer?
Hear his offer? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
That coupler is my prized possession! But I'll bet it on a race. Beat my janitor robot through the sewer tunnels, and it's yours.
Sewer tunnels? Ewww!
I was born for this. Should I race, Cosmo?
Should Gribbo race? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Tula tries to haggle, but the dealer folds his arms.
No race, no part!
There's no other way, Cosmo. And Gribbo's actually really good at racing!
Come on, let me race! Can I?
Should Gribbo race after all? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You try to refuse again, but the dealer just shrugs.
Then good luck with your leaky tree.
Cosmo. Let me do this. Will you let me race?
Let Gribbo race? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Gribbo wipes his hands on his jacket and actually looks focused, which is honestly a bit alarming.
I'm fast. I'm lucky. And I want to help. Also, I did one warm-up stretch. Let me race?
Let Gribbo race? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Gribbo hops onto a rusty hover-scooter. The janitor robot revs its engine.
Ready? Go!
Sewer water sprays everywhere as Gribbo zooms through the pipes! He's neck and neck with the robot!
I can't watch! Cosmo, do you cheer for Gribbo?
Do you cheer for Gribbo? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You can't look. It's too gross, and too close. Sprockle peeks through his fingers.
Cosmo, look! He's still racing! Keep watching?
Keep watching? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Congratulations, this is the grossest race in the history of the galaxy. The janitor robot pulls a little ahead.
Just tell me if he's winning! Keep watching?
Keep watching? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
In a photo finish, Gribbo wins by a nose!
Yee-haw!
He's covered in muck, but he's holding the hydro-valve coupler high!
He did it! Now you can fix the pipe, Cosmo! Ready to get to work?
Ready to fix the pipe? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You don't celebrate yet. The Great Froot Tree is still losing water.
Right. Fix first, party later. Ready to work?
Ready to fix it? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Gribbo is still holding the coupler like a trophy. Then he remembers it's also the thing that saves everyone.
Cosmo. Ready to fix it?
Ready to fix it? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You work fast. Sprockle passes you the tools, one by one.
The spray stops. The pipe is fixed, and the Great Froot Tree's water flows again! Everyone cheers!
Uh, Cosmo? There's an urgent message. Should we listen?
Should we listen to the message? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Not yet, you say. You just want one quiet second.
But the communicator buzzes again, even louder.
Cosmo, we have to hear it. Will you listen?
Listen to the message? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Your communicator is doing a tiny panic-dance in your pocket. One word flashes on the screen: Defense.
We really have to hear this. Listen?
Listen to the message? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
All workers, report to the Great Froot Tree at once! Prepare to defend it from a Mucklar invasion!
But our ship got wrecked in that chase. We're not flying anywhere.
He kicks the smoking engine.
Should we figure out what to do next?
Should we figure out what to do next? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You stare at the smoking engine. For a moment, it feels hopeless. Sprockle nudges you.
Cosmo, you're the one who fixes things. Even impossible things. Will you try?
Try to figure it out? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The engine coughs and spits smoke, like it just swallowed a hairball.
Start with what you know, Cosmo. Will you try?
Try to figure it out? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Another signal! And this one's close!
A battered ship lands nearby. The markings are unmistakable. Veggonauts! Survivors from Vegonnia!
I thought they were all gone! Should we talk to them?
Should we talk to the Veggonauts? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You hold back. What if it's a trap, you whisper?
Maybe. But they're Veggonauts. If they're alive, they have answers. Do we go and talk to them?
Go and talk to them? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The ship's markings are definitely Veggonaut. Either they're friends, or someone made a really good trap costume.
We listen first. Then we decide. Shall we go over?
Go and talk to them? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Listen to me, all of you. King Citrinus of Frootopia is secretly working with the Mucklars! He's calling every defender to the Great Froot Tree, to lead them into a trap!
The king? Cosmo, do you believe them?
Do you believe the Veggonauts? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
How do we know this isn't a Mucklar trick?
The Veggonaut commander shows you recordings of their ruined home world.
We have nothing left to gain from lies.
That's pretty convincing, Cosmo. Do you believe them now?
Do you believe them now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You still don't want to believe it. The commander looks you right in the eye.
If you walk into that trap, you won't walk back out. Stay with us, and we can fight together.
Do you believe them?
Do you believe the commander? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You want it to be a trick. You really, really do. But the recordings are real, and the commander looks tired, not sneaky.
I trust them, Cosmo. Will you?
Do you believe them? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Thank you, Cosmo. We won't forget this.
The team decides not to walk into the king's trap.
But what do we do? We need help!
Then you have an idea. What about the Beastroos, on the planet Zoomara?
The Beastroos? They've never taken sides! Should we try?
Should we ask the Beastroos for help? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You hate the idea of asking strangers for help.
Cosmo, if we don't find friends, we can't win. Head for Zoomara?
Head for Zoomara? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Asking the Beastroos for help makes your tummy twist like a pretzel. Sprockle points to the empty sky where Vegonnia used to be.
We can't do this alone. Should we fly to Zoomara?
Head for Zoomara? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The Veggonauts help repair the ship. But there's a problem.
We don't have enough fuel to reach Zoomara!
I saw an abandoned fuel capsule in the Dead Zone. But it's guarded by an ancient robot.
Sounds dangerous. But we have no choice. Should we go and find it?
Should we go and find the fuel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
An ancient robot, you repeat. That sounds like a bad day.
A bad day, but a necessary day. Shall we go and find the fuel?
Go and find the fuel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
We can't, you say. But then you hear it. Over the radio, a long, tired groan from the Great Froot Tree.
We don't get to stop, Cosmo. Go after the fuel?
Go after the fuel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You try to say no, but your feet start walking anyway. Tula doesn't argue. Gribbo follows. And Sprockle stays right by your side.
Come on, Cosmo.
In the Dead Zone, you find the ancient fuel capsule. A huge robot stands in front of it, eyes glowing.
Solve the riddle, or leave.
Sprockle hides behind you.
Riddles? I'm good at riddles! Want me to try?
Should Sprockle try to solve the riddle? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
No, you whisper. Let me think.
Okay! Okay! You are smart, Cosmo!
I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?
Do you want me to answer after all?
Let Sprockle answer the riddle? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You close your eyes and picture Sprockle's hologram map. Cities. Mountains. Water. But no houses, no trees, no fish. You open your eyes. A map, you say.
Correct.
Cosmo! You did it! Shall we grab the fuel?
Grab the fuel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You look at the fuel. This is really happening.
Zoomara could save us, Cosmo. Ready to fly there?
Ready to fly to Zoomara? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The fuel gauge is finally full. The ship goes quiet for a second, like the universe is holding its breath.
This next stop decides everything. Shall we go?
Ready to fly to Zoomara? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Zoomara is breathtaking. Ancient forests stretch on forever, glowing with magic.
Wow! It's beautiful! The Beastroos live down there. They're wild and wise, and they've never taken sides in any war.
Let's hope they listen. Ready to land?
Should we land on Zoomara? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Not yet, you say. Gribbo circles over the forest while Sprockle scans the trees.
Lots of movement down there. But we can't hover forever. Land now?
Land now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You circle again. Big shapes move under the trees. The landing gear clunks halfway down, then stops, like it's having second thoughts.
They're already watching us. Land now?
Land now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You creep through the forest as quietly as you can. But within minutes, you're surrounded! Huge Beastroo warriors step out of the trees, holding tall wooden staffs.
Cosmo! What do we do?
Tula reaches for her weapon, but you stop her. Should you try talking to them first?
Should we talk to them peacefully? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Tula reaches for her weapon, but the Beastroos are impossibly fast. In seconds, the whole team is surrounded, with nowhere to go.
Bad idea! Bad idea!
Their leader, Shaman Pawra, steps forward.
Speak, and we may let you stay.
Cosmo, say something! Will you speak to her?
Will you speak to Shaman Pawra? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You stay silent. Shaman Pawra tilts her head, studying you like a puzzle.
Silence is also a choice.
Cosmo, maybe we should talk.
Last chance, small one. Will you speak from your heart?
Will you speak from your heart? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.

You keep it practical. I look after the Great Froot Tree's pipes, you say. I know how fragile life is when the water stops. If the Mucklars win, they won't stop at Frootopia. They'll drain every world. Help us, and I promise to protect your forest like it's my own.
He means it.
Shaman Pawra watches you carefully. Do you think it convinced her?
Do you think it convinced her? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The forest stays quiet. Shaman Pawra raises a clawed hand.
Words are easy. Deeds are rare. A life-pipe from your Great Froot Tree runs under these woods. It is cracked, and leaking. Fix it, and we will believe you.
Cosmo, that's literally your job!
Will you accept the challenge?
Will you accept the challenge? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You hesitate. Tula steps forward, kneels, and lays her weapon on the ground.
I lost my world because nobody stood together. I won't let it happen again.
A warrior who bows is either wise, or desperate. We will send a small group of scouts. Earn the rest.
Better than nothing! Ready to go back to Frootopia?
Ready to return to Frootopia? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You look back at the Beastroo scouts gathering in the trees.
We got something. It's enough.
Cosmo, we should move. Back to Frootopia?
Return to Frootopia now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The Beastroo scouts blend into the trees like salad ninjas.
We have to move before the trail goes cold. Back to Frootopia?
Return to Frootopia now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
With the Beastroos on your side, you sneak back into Frootopia. King Citrinus is still sending out fake calls for help, telling everyone to gather at the Great Froot Tree.
It's definitely a trap. Tula knows the Captain of the Royal Guard. Should we contact him?
Should we contact the Guard Captain? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Not yet, you whisper.
Okay. Then what?
Every second we wait, the trap gets tighter. Do we contact the Captain now?
Contact the Captain now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The king's broadcast echoes across the city. It's like a villain's TV advert. But wait, there's more!
We need the Captain before the trap closes. Contact him now?
Contact the Captain now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
Tula's old friend, the Captain of the Royal Guard, confirms everything. The king is trying to open an ancient, forbidden portal to the Mucklars' world!
Cosmo! I could hack into the city's speakers and warn everyone! Should I try?
Should Sprockle hack the city speakers? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The team spreads out, warning people face to face. It's slow, but the news spreads.
I'm hacking in anyway, to make it louder! There! Now, to the Great Froot Tree! Ready?
Head to the tree now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You take one more minute to make sure everyone has heard the warning.
Cosmo, we have to move! To the tree?
Head to the tree now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The city is buzzing. Everyone's shouting, nobody's in charge, and somehow, everyone's looking at you.
If we don't stop that portal, none of this matters. To the tree?
Head to the tree now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
A little robot lemonade seller called Robolade rolls up to you.
Lemonade? Fresh lemonade? No? Then how about a secret tunnel through the ancient pipes?
Those are the same pipes you look after, Cosmo! Just deeper, and older! Should we take the tunnel?
Should we take the secret tunnel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
There's no other way. The king's guards are watching every street.
She's right. And you know pipes better than anyone! Will you lead us through the tunnel?
Will you lead them through the tunnel? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
I don't know those tunnels, you admit.
But you know pipes better than anyone in the galaxy!
Lead us, Cosmo.
Will you lead the way?
Will you lead them? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
The tunnel smells ancient and metallic, with just a hint of bad idea.
You're the pipe expert.
We'll follow you. Lead the way?
Will you lead them? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You lead the way through the twisting tunnels. Ancient carvings cover the walls.
These are from Frootopia's forgotten past!
At last, you climb out near the roots of the Great Froot Tree. And what you see is terrifying.
Cosmo, look! Should we look at what's happening?
Look at what's happening? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You don't want to look. Not yet.
Cosmo, it's really bad. Will you look?
Do you look? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You can hear chanting up ahead. The air is humming.
Whatever's happening, it's happening right now. Look?
Do you look? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
King Citrinus stands in front of the Great Froot Tree, arms raised. Dark energy crackles around an ancient portal, and it's already opening!
The portal! It's happening! Do we stop him now?
Do we stop the king now? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You wait, looking for the right moment. But the portal keeps growing!
It's now or never!
Tula charges forward, and the team follows.
Come on, Cosmo! Will you join the fight?
Will you join the fight? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You try to hold back, but there's no time. Tula grabs your arm and pulls you along.
Stay close, Cosmo! Keep going?
Keep going? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
A wave of gloomy darkness rolls out of the portal, and everybody gasps. Tula blocks a guard's staff, inches from your nose.
Don't stop now! Keep going?
Keep going? Say yes, or no.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Just say yes, or no.
You wait too long. The portal opens wide, the darkness pours out, and one by one, the lights of Frootopia go out.
